name: BidSkim - UK Tenders & Contract Renewals
author: BidSkim
description: UK procurement intelligence: live tenders, contract renewals with incumbents, service markets, frameworks, and buyer/supplier profiles

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search live and historical UK public-sector tenders by keyword, CPV code, region, value range and deadline.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Full detail for one tender notice, including framework and certification context.

tools.name: search_renewals
tools.description: Contracts expiring soon: expiry dates, incumbent suppliers, recurrence evidence and buyer contacts.

tools.name: search_organisations
tools.description: Find public-sector buyers and suppliers by name.

tools.name: get_buyer
tools.description: A buyer's award history, spend patterns and top suppliers.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: A supplier's contract wins, buyers served and market footprint.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Meaning-based search over live tenders — find opportunities like a described capability.

tools.name: my_pipeline
tools.description: The signed-in user's saved tenders and matches on BidSkim.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find which of about 1,700 services a kind of work belongs to, with its size over the last 12 months.

tools.name: get_service_market
tools.description: The market for one service: who buys it, who wins it, totals, open tenders and contracts ending in the next 12 months.

tools.name: similar_contracts
tools.description: For an open tender: past awards judged to be the same job, with winner, value and named bidders where published.

tools.name: search_frameworks
tools.description: Search UK framework agreements, dynamic purchasing systems and dynamic markets by service, supplier, operator or end date.

tools.name: get_framework
tools.description: One framework agreement: who runs it, its term, the suppliers on it and the contracts called off under it.

tools.name: my_profile
tools.description: The signed-in user's company profile and the services it follows on BidSkim.
